rival_note: K retains the entire nominal/property inventory and names processes as catalogue fields. It does not assert execution, source-to-output identity, or historical temporal sequence. Changed process/nominal syntax is explicit, not confirmed by fewer obligations.
grammar_assumptions: Whole forms have fixed values; no productive prefix or suffix decoding.
Lists may omit conjunctions. Adjacent property runs may distribute over the immediately preceding explicitly nominated material list; exact attachments are stored, not claimed automatically learned.
A process can use the preceding result as an implicit patient only when an explicit event binding records that supplementation.
Repeated material names identify classes; same physical batch is separately stipulated. Paragraphs never share a physical batch.
daiin is hypothesized abgemessen, not a numeral or equal positive mass. This is a new interpretation, not a repair of S06 under its original assumptions.
The catalogue rival preserves all words and property repetitions. It gives no event genealogy.

changes.reason: Avoid an unearned extraction process; preparation can be mixed. Recurrent form changes in both paragraphs, no old experiment altered.
Connect written A/B/C parts with prior juice to the preparation; singleton hypothesis, not inferred evidence.
Add dry A-rest to previous wet mixture before dividing wet outputs. This singleton value is chosen to remove a v01 conditional contradiction.
Generate powder before portioning and separation. Singleton value chosen to close v01 missing production.

interpretation_limits: Every material name, physical state and operation value remains stipulated. Formal references do not independently establish any material link.
Process grammar mixes instructions and material annotations. Catalogue rival records the same concepts without asserting the entire execution graph.
External entities are written or implicit supplies, not claims of author-observed existing stocks.
All action occurrences are represented, but an aligned clause can still contain supplemented, unwritten action wording; clause notes expose it.
decision: Joint hypothesis fully word-aligned, graph constraints remain conditional; no semantic winner over catalogue.
